On The 22 nd Of May, 2023
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 19721 of 2023
Between:-
Khubiram S/O Rajjulal, Aged About 72 Years,
Occupation: Retired R/O Chandra Nagar

Gwalior (Madhya Pradesh)
 .....Applicant

(BY SHRI PRAMOD GOHADKAR - ADVOCATE)
AND THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE STATION ANTRI, GWALIOR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .....RESPONDENT

(BY SHRI S.S. KUSHWAHA - PUBLIC PROSECUTOR AND SHRI NITIN GOYAL - ADVOCATE FOR COMPLAINANT)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER With consent heard finally.
The applicant has filed this first bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 10.04.2023 by Police Station Antri District Gwalior in connection with Crime No.25/2023 registered for offence punishable under Sections 420, 465, 466, 467, 470, 471 and 120B and 107 of IPC.
It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is suffering confinement since 10.04.2023 and charge-sheet has already been filed.
Learned counsel for the applicant inform this Court that matter pertains to documentary evidence.
Applicant does not bear any criminal record.
Confinement since 10.04.2023 amounts to pretrial detention.
He undertakes to cooperate in trial and would abide by all the terms and condition as imposed by this Court.
Thus, he prayed for bail.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of this application.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the complainant also opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.

Considering the submission and the arguments advanced by the counsel for the parties, but without commenting on the merits of the case, it is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance from the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules/directions.

(ANAND PATHAK) V. JUDGE Prachi PRACHI MISHRA 2023.05.23 11:04:46 +05'30'
